contentPattern: Optional row with a placeholder picture (click-to-play), then a row with the video URL as a link or plain text (YouTube, youtu.be, Vimeo, or any embeddable URL). Renders a responsive 16:9 rounded iframe, lazy-loaded when it scrolls into view.
usage: Inline YouTube video player (how-to / product explainer videos) in a rounded 16:9 frame within article content.
reuseGuidance: Use for third-party hosted videos (YouTube/Vimeo). For self-hosted MP4 or promo videos with a poster frame and branded border use video-promo.
